Container.Name: BudTube
Container.Overview: BudTube — a self-contained, 420-friendly gaming video platform (21+). YouTube-style uploads, channels, likes, comments, subscriptions, an owner/admin system, and an age gate with optional Didit ID verification. SQLite database and video files live on the /data volume.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the BudTube web interface

Config.Name: Data (database + videos)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database and uploaded videos/thumbnails

Config.Name: Admin (owner) password
Config.Description: Password for the owner account (created/updated on every start). 8+ characters.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Random string used to sign login cookies. Set once and keep it stable.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Owner account username (lowercase letters, digits, underscore)

Config.Name: Didit API key
Config.Description: Optional: enables ID-document age verification via didit.me (free tier 500/mo)

Config.Name: Didit workflow ID
Config.Description: Didit workflow UUID from your dashboard

Config.Name: Didit monthly cap
Config.Description: Hard cap on Didit checks per month (stays under the 500 free tier)
